system.description: A handheld tool that carries a small reserve of plasmoleum. A flick of the thumb produces a small arc of crackling energy, and with a twist of the dial it turns into a steady beam of light. Used as a flashlight, cigarette lighter, welding torch, or for anything from supercharging firearm rounds, overloading electronic systems, or even jamming into a knife’s hilt to jury-rig a quick electro-blade.
